title: fix(search): don't update widgets if props hasn't changed

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @Morhaus, @bobylito and @vvo to be potential reviewers
Can you remove the commit about docs on multiple instances?
Could you walk us briefly around this bugfix? When what this happening?

Bug: when managing the state of InstantSearch externally, several identical queries were sent to Algolia. 

Root cause: The componentWillReceiveProps hook of React gets called for both the InstantSearch root component and the widgets. But since we don't check for the props equality we're doing a new search even if their props are still the same.
